issues.issue: Was the May 4, 2016 refusal letter unreasonable because it did not explain why the mitigation plan was inadequate?
issues.applicant_position: The letter gave no reasons why the plan was rejected, so the decision is unreasonable and unintelligible.
issues.result_quote: The application for judicial review must therefore be dismissed.

issues.issue: Was the assessment of the child's needs generic rather than individualized, contrary to Hilewitz?
issues.applicant_position: The assessment of the child's Down syndrome was generic, relying on the classification of the condition (memorandum).
issues.result_quote: he did not claim that the assessment performed in this case was not individualized
